content.title: Carvana Stock Falls on Short-Seller Report Alleging Overstated Earnings
content.summary: Shares in high-flying used-car retailer Carvana closed down 14% on Wednesday after the release of a short seller’s report that alleged the company’s earnings are “far more dependent” than previously known on private companies linked to Carvana’s controlling shareholders.  Carvana, a nationwide seller of used cars known for its online process, has had a dramatic turnaround from bankruptcy rumors in late 2022 to a market cap of about $104 billion before today’s stock plunge.  Gotham published the 2024 audited financials of DriveTime Automotive Group, Inc. and Bridgecrest Acceptance Corp., which are owned by Ernest Garcia II, the father of Carvana Chief Executive Ernest Garcia III.
